key_reviews.en: {count, plural, =1 {{count_display} wake armed} other {{count_display} wakes armed}}
key_reviews.ru: {count, plural, =1 {{count_display} пробуждение запланировано} one {{count_display} пробуждение запланировано} few {{count_display} пробуждения запланированы} many {{count_display} пробуждений запланировано} other {{count_display} пробуждения запланировано}}

context.role: count clause naming how many scheduled wakes are armed, on the composer's wakes chip and as the trailing tally of the run panel's Wakes section
context.tone: short status clause, lowercase after the number, no trailing punctuation
context.note: A wake is a scheduled follow-up the agent set for itself; armed means it is set and will fire. One string serves both surfaces so they cannot drift. Provide every CLDR plural category the language needs.

placeholders.count: Numeric selector for CLDR plural categories. English uses exact =1 to preserve the original strict count === 1 branch; translators add their CLDR arms.
placeholders.count_display: Raw String(count), preserving the former JavaScript interpolation without rounding or grouping. Print this, not count.

context.role: cadence of a wake that fires a single time, in a wake row and inside the schedule sentences that quote a wake's repeat
context.note: Opposite of 'every {duration}'. It is embedded mid-sentence by other strings (for example 'keep as once'), so it must read as a lowercase adverb.

limits.fit: Static character/cell-risk inspection only; no measured pixel fit. No numeric maxCells/maxChars hints on the five keys.
limits.validator: Pinned repository locale-parity.test.mjs, byte-identical, on scratch snapshots of only the two assigned namespace files. 6 Russian tests passed; not a whole-repository gate.

semantic_review.effort: Низкий / Средний / Высокий are idiomatic masculine level labels, ordered correctly; six/seven/seven Cyrillic characters, no combining or wide-script glyphs. Raw picker and slash values remain English tokens.
semantic_review.armed_count: Запланировано/запланированы correctly communicates an armed scheduled follow-up, not a completed wake. Пробуждение follows the glossary. Exact =1 plus one/few/many/other all preserve appropriate noun case and predicate agreement, including fractional other.
semantic_review.cadence_once: однократно is a lowercase adverb meaning one-time, natural standalone after the due-label separator. Read all direct call sites: wake cadence, monitor interval, schedules. keepRepeatLabel takes a separate keep_as_once branch for null intervals; repeating legacy schedule cadence uses non-null intervals, so no newly broken keep/starts/until embedding.
semantic_review.copy_constraints: No markup, Rich tags, backtick code, flags, commands or identifiers occur in these five values; no translator-authored Cf characters. Five target keys present and non-English; no fallback required at the catalogue boundary.

call_sites: 202-208 separate one-time keep label;718-739 repeating legacy cadence
